razor_priya: Pattern: I defaulted to sink_ba_ba1. Reality: It consistently rests on bathroom_shelf_ba1. Next time: Always check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first.

mug_priya: Pattern: I incorrectly assumed it moved to the bedroom nightstand or cupboard early in the day. Reality: It remained at kitchen_table_k1 at 08:21. It frequently shifts between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. Next time: Check kitchen_table_k1 first in the morning; do not assume cupboard or bedroom movement without specific evidence.

glass_priya: Pattern: I failed to track its late-evening locations, defaulting to coffee_table_l1 or kitchen_table_k1. Reality: It was at kitchen_table_k1 at 19:47, cupboard_k1 at 20:20, and nightstand_b1 at 22:32. It moves unpredictably in the evening, including to the bedroom. Next time: Check nightstand_b1 for very late evening queries; do not assume it stays in the living room or kitchen after 20:00.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I assumed it stayed on kitchen_table_k1. Reality: It was at dish_rack_k1 at 20:21. Next time: Check dish_rack_k1 if the item is not on the table, especially in the evening.

General Note: Items like glass_priya show high mobility in the evening, moving to unexpected spots like the bedroom nightstand or kitchen cupboard. Do not assume static positions in the living room after 20:00. Prioritize checking nightstand_b1 for late-night queries and cupboard_k1 for mid-evening queries.
